## Description

Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At [Coinbase](https://www.coinbase.com/?utm_campaign=mt_o_m_w_m_m__coi_0_jd-onchain&utm_source=coinbase), we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” [learn more about working at Coinbase](https://www.coinbase.com/careers).

This is a 12-week internship during summer 2027.

You'll join the Acceleration Programs team within the Talent Density pillar of our People Team, which works to cultivate a culture that attracts, recognizes, and accelerates top talent. As an intern, you'll align with one or more critical projects that support our number one operating priority: top talent in every seat. You'll flex program design, project management, and analytical skills while contributing to work that unlocks employees' ability to have a major impact at Coinbase.

**What you'll do:**

- Support program design by actively contributing to brainstorms, working sessions, and development of project plans, timelines, and deliverables
- Partner with Talent Density team members and cross-functional People Team partners to execute program logistics end-to-end
- Gather and analyze feedback from various sources to assess program effectiveness and contribute actionable recommendations for future iterations
- Build and maintain documentation for new and existing processes to ensure scalability and clear communication across stakeholders

**Required Skills and Experience:**

- Demonstrated experience managing a project from initial concept to completion, including setting timelines and tracking deliverables
- Analytical and problem-solving capability with a data-driven approach to decision-making
- Organizational skills sufficient to balance multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a remote environment without close oversight
- Clear written and verbal communication with the ability to collaborate effectively across teams
- Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality.
